authors: Christian Schittenkopf; Georg Dorffner; Engelbert J. Dockner
title: Identifying Stochastic Processes with Mixture Density Networks
locator: PDF pp.1–2 cover/identity; pp.5–6 (printed pp.2–3), Section2, Eqs.(1)–(9); PDFp.8 (printedp.5), Section3 ATX experiment; provider lines0–15,100–189,318–342.
target: A conditional financial-series density and the ATX squared-return volatility proxy; not the population-centered rolling seven-return sigma7 target.
mechanism: Gaussian mixture with learned component means, variances and softmax masses, each predicted by MLPs.
loss_training: Negative log likelihood, Eq.(8); single-Gaussian special case Eq.(9); scaled/conjugate-gradient optimization.
V3_difference: Three ordered positive atoms model U=|r_future-m6|; their sample-dependent sigma7 images are averaged, with MSE_sigma +0.1 CRPS_U instead of Gaussian NLL.
known_not_claimed: Neural conditional densities, learned mixture masses and financial volatility application are established.
bounded_finding: The inspected equations do not implement the missing-return-magnitude law plus the exact six-known/one-unknown sigma7 push-forward. This comparison is not an absence proof beyond this source.

authors: Jacopo De Stefani; Olivier Caelen; Dalila Hattab; Gianluca Bontempi
title: Machine Learning for Multi-step Ahead Forecasting of Volatility Proxies
locator: PDFp.3 (printedp.3), Section2, Eq.(1); PDFpp.6–7, Section3 Eqs.(17)–(22); PDFp.9, Section4.1 and beginning4.3; provider lines78–106,363–486,643–650,736–740.
target: Defines rolling centered standard deviation with denominator n−1; the observed experiment forecasts proxy sigma4 across CAC40 daily OHLC series. Do not claim its reported experiment used exact sigma7.
mechanism: Direct NAR/NARX forecasting from lagged proxy values; MLP with linear-autoregressive and nonlinear terms; additional-proxy inputs.
loss_training: MLP/nnet with hidden-width cross-validation; the inspected methods do not supply the V3 finite-law CRPS objective. No claim about an unobserved exact implementation loss.
V3_difference: Rather than directly regress a volatility proxy, V3 learns a folded one-return law and hardcodes the known six-return contribution in its readout. Changing n or ddof alone is not this adaptation.
known_not_claimed: Rolling-SD forecasting with neural regressors and OHLC financial data is not a new problem family.
bounded_finding: No finite atomic U-law, sample-specific push-forward g_A or MSE_sigma+CRPS_U appears in the inspected Eq.(17)–(22) model.

authors: Grzegorz Dudek; Witold Orzeszko; Piotr Fiszeder
title: Probabilistic Forecasting Cryptocurrencies Volatility: From Point to Quantile Forecasts
locator: SectionII Eq.(1) and text (HTML lines93–111); SectionIII-A Eqs.(2)–(4), III-B/C (lines112 onward); IV results lines305–323.
target: Next-day BTC realized variance from288 intraday five-minute returns;99 forecast quantiles.
mechanism: Residual-simulation/KDE forecasts and quantile-linear/forest stacking of point-model outputs.
loss_training: Quantile models and probabilistic forecasts scored with CRPS; CRPS is an evaluation metric here and must not be conflated with V3 auxiliary CRPS_U training.
V3_difference: V3 learns latent magnitude atoms with an exact input-dependent readout before averaging, rather than adding residuals to a point volatility forecast or fitting quantiles to stacked point inputs.
known_not_claimed: Probabilistic BTC volatility forecasts, quantiles, ensembles and CRPS evaluation are established.
bounded_finding: The examined methods do not implement the sigma7 overlap identity or the V3 U-law training/readout. RV=sum of intraday squares and centered daily rolling sigma7 are different estimands.

authors: Rafael Reisenhofer; Xandro Bayer; Nikolaus Hautsch
title: HARNet: A Convolutional Neural Network for Realized Volatility Forecasting
locator: Section2 Eqs.(3)–(5), HTML lines65–85; Section4.1 Eqs.(18)–(21), lines174–187; Section4.2 initialization and4.3 loss discussion; rechecked lines38–64.
target: Daily realized variance, sum of intraday squared returns; stock-index forecasting.
mechanism: Dilated causal convolution hierarchy and explicit HAR-baseline initialization.
loss_training: Initialization from HAR estimates; MSE,MAE,QLIKE losses compared; no learned folded-return atomic law in the examined architecture.
V3_difference: The financial identity is moved into the output map over a learned U law; V3 does not reproduce HAR filters/initialization and cannot inherit HARNet guarantees.
known_not_claimed: Causal convolutions, financial inductive bias and changing a volatility loss are established ideas.
bounded_finding: Difference from HARNet is verified, but difference from a guide paper alone is not sufficient novelty evidence.
